headline: Peru's ProInversión to Auction Petroperú Real Estate Assets Worth $9.6 Million
summary: Peru's private investment promotion agency ProInversión announced the upcoming auction of nine real estate plots owned by state oil company Petroperú, valued at $9.6 million, as part of a non-core asset divestment program.
why: Asset sales by state oil firms assist in raising liquidity and restructuring corporate balance sheets under public oversight.
